verdict.rationale: Jan's Settings docs cover managing downloaded models: importing GGUF files from disk and searching the Hub by Hugging Face ID, and the changelog adds pause/resume for model downloads. Custom Assistants offer a way to save reusable instructions/personas that can be assigned to projects, which partially covers saved prompts. There is no evidence of per-model configuration (e.g., inference parameters per model) or that models, prompts and configs are managed together in one unified place. missing for 10: per-model configuration settings, evidence of a unified management view across models/prompts/configs, a dedicated saved-prompt library beyond assistant instructions, independent or hands-on corroboration
